title: Victory Counter
description: Shared, always-visible progress tracks for any game system. The GM creates any number of named tracks (e.g. Infiltration Points, Guard Awareness, Doomsday Device Activation), each with its own target, positive/negative polarity, optional progress ring, and player visibility. Every player sees the same live state on screen. System-agnostic: the module stores its entire state in its own settings and never reads or writes any world document.
